title: Bunny Shaw's hat-trick sends Man City top of the WSL
lead: Manchester City beat West Ham 5-0 and their Jamaican striker Khadija Shaw scored three goals.
body: On Saturday 7 November 2026, Manchester City Women played West Ham at home, at the Joie Stadium. City won 5-0, and their Jamaican striker Khadija Shaw scored a hat-trick: three goals in one match!

Shaw, called "Bunny" by her fans, scored the first goal just before half-time. After the break, she scored again with a header from a cross by Lauren Hemp. Then two other City players, Aoba Fujino and Iman Beney, scored too. Late in the game, Shaw got her third goal.

On the same day, Chelsea were top of the table, but they only drew 1-1 with Everton at Stamford Bridge. Everton's goal was an own goal by the Chelsea defender Lucy Bronze. So Manchester City have gone back to the top of the WSL.
Shaw has scored in every WSL match she has started this season, and she is the top scorer in the league. Can anyone stop her?
